body:
🟠🧹 **Fix · cleanup: Swift Package Manager build cache committed by accident**

`.build/CACHEDIR.TAG` and `.build/.buildSystem_debug` are generated by Swift Package Manager. The file itself says "This file is a cache directory tag created by (Swift Package Manager)". The repository has no `Package.swift`, `.gitignore` has no `.build` entry, and the PR body doesn't mention these files. They look like local build output that got staged with the docs change. Remove both files from the PR, and consider adding `.build/` to `.gitignore` so they don't come back.

🟠📝 **Fix · docs: "Every content folder autogenerates" is false for `stack/` and `authentication/`**

`apps/documentation/astro.config.mjs:33-36` still lists the Stack group by hand (`stack/hono`, `stack/better-auth-electron-bug`), and `astro.config.mjs:73-81` does the same for Authentication. Getting Started is also a manual list at line 23. So a new page created under `stack/` or `authentication/` won't appear in the sidebar, even though this rule says "creating the page is enough" and "no sidebar list". Either switch those two groups to `autogenerate: { directory: ... }` the way this PR does for Desktop App and Backlog, or reword the rule to name the folders that are still listed by hand.

`.build/.buildSystem_debug` and `.build/CACHEDIR.TAG` are a Swift Package Manager build cache that got committed by accident. They have nothing to do with this PR. The root `.gitignore` ignores `build` but not `.build`, so this will happen again. Remove both files from the commit (`git rm --cached -r .build`) and add `.build/` to `.gitignore` under `# Build outputs`.

No page in `desktop/` sets `sidebar.order`, so autogenerate sorts the group alphabetically. `analytics-and-flags` now comes first, and `product-philosophy`, which the old list put first as the entry point, drops to ninth. Adding `sidebar: { order: 1 }` to the frontmatter of `desktop/product-philosophy.mdx` keeps it on top without bringing back a list in the config.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**
